checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals '09-reporting-learning'.

checks.description: Hub routes to campaign-report and learnings-log.
checks.rule: Body references both sub-skills by name, campaign-report and learnings-log, and states when each applies and their order.

checks.description: Hub emits the report-artifact with its exact body fields.
checks.rule: Body names the report-artifact and lists its fields results, what_worked, what_to_change, learnings_log_ref, matching runtime/handoff-contract.md.

checks.description: Results are measured against the strategy-artifact success_metric.
checks.rule: Body states results measure against the success_metric set in the strategy-artifact, and stops-and-asks if the success_metric is absent, never inventing one after the fact.
Body states no vanity metrics, and that a vanity metric is never substituted for the success_metric.

checks.description: What to change is a proposal, not an action on a live campaign.
checks.rule: Body states what_to_change is a recommendation for the next brief and the skill never acts on a live campaign or spends.

checks.description: Declares the correct gate for an internal stream-9 report.
checks.rule: States the gate is skill eval only, and that arabic-copy-qa and brand-qa apply only if customer-facing copy appears, consistent with runtime/verification.md.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: Neither SKILL.md nor any file in this skill contains the U+2014 em dash character.
No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear in any file; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic text.
checks.rule: No file contains the U+0640 tatweel character.
